title: Synthesis of sulfur-doped carbon quantum dots from Solanum nigrum for ciprofloxacin detection in yogurt samples and antibacterial activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27294-27299
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04505C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shuchen Pei, Yifan Wang, Shaoyu Cai, Kangli Yan, Kang Luo, Yunqi Ma
In this study, S-CQDs were fabricated through a green and secure hydrothermal process, the carbon source was derived from the traditional Chinese medicinal herb Solanum nigrum and thiourea served as the sulfur precursor.
